risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed hawkish surprise / additional rate hikes
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge equity with short-duration bonds; increase allocation to rate-sensitive sectors (utilities, REITs) as yield curve normalizes; monitor Warsh commentary for timing cues

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil supply shock / Iran war escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight energy producers (XLE, XOM); underweight airlines and transport; maintain 10-15% energy allocation; monitor Saudi pipeline repair timeline
Maintain 10-15% gold allocation; diversify geographically; avoid concentrated EM Asia exposure; monitor defense stocks (LMT, RTX) as hedges
Diversify AI exposure beyond single-name concentration; favor regulated incumbents (MSFT, IBM) over speculative pure-plays; monitor Congress AI legislation timeline
Reduce EM bond exposure; favor hard-currency EM equities; monitor Turkey fund liquidation spillover and Indonesia state-bank concentration risk
Increase cash to 15-20%; trim momentum positions; follow Buffett's warning by favoring quality over growth; avoid chasing dead-cat bounces in overextended names

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Fed hawkish pivot and $103 oil create headwinds; Dow -630 pts signals risk-off. Expect 5-10% volatility in equities. Bonds rally on rate expectations but yields at 5% cap upside. Currency volatility (Yen, Yuan, Dollar) adds noise. 2-3 week consolidation likely before next catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. European 8-year bullish consensus, AI structural growth, and commodity supercycle support medium-term upside. However, Iran war persistence, AI regulation, and potential 2nd Fed hike cap multiples. 6-12 month path: grind higher in quality/energy, choppy in speculative growth.
